настройки.accounts.кнопка.подсказка: Reread the database from the server and show the collector
настройки.accounts.пояснение: The nick database is shared by every browser — it lives on the server, not in the page memory. It is filled by the collector bookmark launched on the site itself: from there the catalogue is reachable, while for us it is closed by Cloudflare protection.
настройки.act.пояснение: The server weighs chunks of the lowest track of the rooms from the history and judges how lively the scene is by their spread — the bars left of the time. It counts against each room's own norm, because resolution and encoder differ everywhere. The first estimate appears after about two minutes: at least a dozen chunks have to pile up. Only those currently live are polled; no video is downloaded, just the chunk size is asked for.
настройки.buffer.пояснение: Depth of instant rewind. While recording to disk it is a quick cache on top of the file, without recording — the whole available depth. An hour of 720p ≈ 1 GB of memory.
настройки.catalog.пояснение: The server polls the live list on the site by itself — this is the main source of the right column: about 1200 rooms with correct server numbers. The player's own sweep finds far fewer, because it only knows the previous servers, and models move between them. Asking more often than twice a minute is pointless: the site refuses rapid series of requests.
настройки.deep.пояснение: Grey nicks in the history are swept across every broadcast server at once: the model may not have left but moved to another server — then the ordinary check calls her gone. The sweep is heavy, so it runs on a schedule; the ↻ button above the history starts it right away.
настройки.deepBatch.пояснение: History nicks that did not answer on their own server are tried across all 105 servers: the model may have moved. One such nick costs up to 105 requests and about 10 seconds, so a batch is taken per pass, starting with those unchecked the longest — over a couple of cycles the queue covers everyone. The ↻ button in the history starts the check right away.
настройки.dirCancel.кнопка.подсказка: Close, keeping the previous recording folder
настройки.dirPick.кнопка.подсказка: Record here. The path will be saved in the server settings
настройки.gap.пояснение: How often the player may start a full sweep on its own. The ↻ button ignores the pause.
настройки.hist.пояснение: How often the left column rechecks whether previously watched nicks are live. Only their last known server is asked — that is quick; the search across every server lives in «Look for movers».
настройки.keepMin.пояснение: Recording is always on — it is what gives rewind deeper than memory holds. On moving to another room the player will ask whether to keep the file or wipe it; short recordings are wiped silently, they were only needed as a buffer.
настройки.ladder.пояснение: The server weighs the tracks of the rooms from the history in advance and keeps the result, so that the player picks quality by real numbers from the very first second. Without that, the first couple of seconds are decided by what the manifest declares, where 720p sometimes claims 3.4 Mbit/s at a real 0.65 — and the picker manages to drop the quality, especially on the first room after a page reload. The value sets the shelf life of a measurement; the check runs once a minute, so a new room in the history is measured at once.
настройки.lang.пояснение: «Same as the browser» takes the language from its settings if a dictionary exists for it, otherwise it leaves Russian. A language picked by hand is stronger: changing the system locale will not override it. The list grows by itself — dictionaries are files in the lang folder next to the server, and adding a language needs no edits either in the page or in the server.
настройки.libDir.пояснение: Where the «Video» button takes files from. Any folder inside /mnt/DATA, /mnt/Projects and /home/vladimir will do — the server will not let you past them, it is visible to the whole local network. Write permission is not needed here, unlike in the recordings folder: here we only read. Subfolders are not walked.
настройки.maxRate.пояснение: Cuts off tracks that are too heavy: out of those that fit, the largest resolution is taken. Tracks cannot be compared by bitrate — the top one comes from the model as is, while the lower ones are re-encoded on the fly by the CDN and are often twice as wasteful. Plain lies happen too: a track declares 3.4 Mbit/s and delivers 2.1. The bitrate of every track is visible in the «Quality» list. «Auto» obeys this ceiling as well and leans on measured values rather than declared ones. If not a single track fits under the ceiling, the lightest one plays: showing something beats showing nothing.
настройки.msgs.пояснение: The line on the right of the top bar: who left the air, what was copied, how many streams were stopped. Switch it off if it distracts. Errors are shown in any case — a silent bar during a breakdown is worse than a needless line.
настройки.net.кнопка.подсказка: Delays and losses to the router, neutral nodes and broadcast servers
настройки.net.пояснение: Pings the router, neutral nodes and broadcast servers one by one and shows the delay and the loss for each. Needed when the picture falls apart: it shows at once whether the channel is to blame and on which leg.
настройки.orphanClose.кнопка.подсказка: Leave as is: the question will come back on the next start
настройки.orphanDropAll.кнопка.подсказка: Wipe every unfinished chunk without joining — this cannot be undone
настройки.orphanKeepAll.кнопка.подсказка: Join every folder into its own mp4 and remove the chunks
настройки.panelRight.пояснение: The blue handles at the edges of the video do the same.
настройки.pool.пояснение: More means a faster sweep but a heavier load on the network. The database currently holds a few thousand nicks.
настройки.pull.пояснение: How often the page fetches the shared nick database from the server. While the collector bookmark works in a neighbouring tab, the database grows every minute, and open players pick up new server numbers from here.
настройки.recDir.пояснение: Where the server puts the files. Paths inside /mnt/DATA, /mnt/Projects and /home/vladimir are allowed — the rest will be closed for writing by systemd. Earlier recordings stay where they were.
настройки.recMode.пояснение: In auto every opened stream is written — that is the rewind buffer itself. By hand, recording starts only from the button in the top bar.
настройки.recRate.пояснение: If the stream is heavier, the server re-encodes it down to this bitrate on the graphics card, keeping the resolution. «Same as while watching» writes the stream as is, without re-encoding.
настройки.segment.пояснение: The chunks ffmpeg cuts the recording into; once it ends they are joined into a single mp4. Short ones mean more files, but a fresher switch point for the «From recording» button.
настройки.thumbs.пояснение: The CDN itself redraws the frames about once every 10 seconds.
настройки.ttl.пояснение: While the result is fresh, the list is taken from the server on page load without a sweep.
настройки.wallCols.пояснение: How many columns to lay the cells out in; there will be as many rows as needed. «Auto» tries every layout and takes the one where the frame comes out larger for the current window shape: on a wide screen two streams will stand side by side rather than one below the other — that way each is almost twice as large. An explicit number is needed when the order matters: «1» puts the cells strictly in a column, «2» with eight cells gives a tall 2×4 grid, «4» a wide 4×2 one.
настройки.wallQ.пояснение: The ceiling on track height in the cells. The largest one no higher than this value is taken. On a quarter of the screen the difference between 480p and 1080p is practically invisible, while decoding 1080p costs four times more: a measurement gave 9× real time per core for 480p against roughly 2× for 1080p.
настройки.warm.пояснение: How many seconds after the start to hold the chosen quality without listening to the channel estimate. A fresh connection does not speed up at once: a measurement on ten servers showed that the first chunk understates the capability fourfold — 2.5 against 9.8 Mbit/s — while the connection reaches 80% of its limit in 4.2 seconds by the median and 8.3 in the worst case. Five seconds by default cover half the cases; if the quality still collapses at the start, it is worth raising it to ten. Zero brings back the old behaviour, when the picker trusts the estimate from the very first second and drops the quality out of the blue.
